function.name: check_report_coverage
function.description: FREE. Return honest nearby point-of-interest counts and the list of report chapters available for a coordinate, so you can decide whether ordering a paid Parcelabot report is worthwhile. No payment is made. If coverage_level is 'none' or 'sparse', the local data is thin — confirm with the user before ordering. Always call this before order_full_report.

radius_km.description: Optional search radius in km (0..50). Defaults to the server setting.

function.name: order_full_report
function.description: PAID via the x402 protocol (USDC on an EVM chain, e.g. Base). Order a full parcel-level Parcelabot due-diligence report for a coordinate, pay for it autonomously, wait for rendering, and return the report as Markdown. Requires a funded EVM wallet configured in the handler. Call check_report_coverage first and confirm with the user when coverage is thin. One report per call.
